facts.text: The image is a composite character-reference sheet: one large cinematic hero image at the top, three full-body studio views in the middle row, and four detail crops in the bottom row, with centered uppercase labels.
In the top hero panel, a person stands on a wet urban walkway or bridge at night in the rain, with metal railings on both sides and dark buildings behind.
The hero panel has visible rain streaks, reflective wet pavement, a cool light source from the upper left, and distant warm amber lights and bokeh.
The person has short shaved sides with dark hair gathered into a small top knot, a lean or athletic build, and a visible small mark or scar above one eyebrow.
The person wears a black high-collared tactical jacket with chest straps and buckles, a dark gray crew-neck shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The middle-row panel labeled FRONT shows a full-body frontal studio view against a dark gray backdrop, with the person standing and arms at the sides.
The middle-row panel labeled SIDE PROFILE shows the person facing left in profile, with the top knot visible and arms relaxed at the sides.
The middle-row panel labeled BACK shows a rear view of the person and the jacket’s back seams and paneling against a dark studio backdrop.
The bottom-left panel labeled FACE is a close crop of the same person’s face, showing shaved sides, the base of the top knot, and a neutral expression looking toward the camera.
The detail panel labeled JACKET COLLAR shows black fabric with metal buckle-and-strap hardware and a high collar.
The detail panel labeled HANDS shows two relaxed hands with visible veins and textured, weathered skin.
The detail panel labeled BOOTS shows black lace-up combat boots with worn leather and thick soles.
Visible labels on the composite read HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
